<!-- pr-reviewer: 0285309868c56ac6ab6710cd750cba551f035ff0 -->
Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework` for the two items below.

This is the first review. I read the complete diff and checked the current upstream rules. The alias table preserves both old names. The command, project-load, option-key, and undo checks pass. `Process change: yes` is present. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

**Local build and tests**

I tested the trial merge `7fe5e43f058596081119e5bfcbe12d73e7dad851` with main `138a592a196a6c68e8608b560fbd2696977a71c7`. Its first parent is the PR head above. No GitHub runner ran. The cache wrapper stalled during the initial planner build. I stopped that build and ran verification with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: the geometry text change selected the batch fallback. All builds passed. Of 1,216 steps, 1,213 passed and three UI steps failed. There were no stalls. Clippy with `-D warnings` passed.
- `wire_post_alias`: 6 passed. `agie_native`: 37 passed. `conformance`: 7 passed. `mcp_wire_contour`: 9 passed. `plasma_post_refusals`: 7 passed.
- `comment_escape`: 4 passed. Geometry lib: 77 passed. All three changed `egui_app::tests::agie_post` tests passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --only motion --only app`: all 11 light tests passed across five targets. This selects every light test. It omits the broad release prebuild; Cargo builds each selected target. No full heavy lane ran.

**Extra suites run**

These suites ran by name in the quick fallback:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `script_agie_native`: 11 passed. This suite reads the changed refusal directory through `recorded::check`.
- The other post golden suites passed. Kernel `step_agreement`: 29 passed; kernel `machining_mesh`: 7 passed; app `feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed. No importer code or STEP fixture changed.

**Host failures checked on bare main**

This headless host has no GPU adapter available to these tests. I ran the same three UI suites on bare main `138a592a1`:

```text
cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test egui_app --test shell --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=6
```

Both trees give the same results:

| Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| UI lib | 1671 | 7 | 8 |
| UI egui_app | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| UI shell | 20 | 1 | 0 |

The failed test names match exactly. Six report-picture tests fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The other five failures report `no graphics adapter` or the resulting nonzero CLI exit code. These are pre-existing host failures. They do not block this PR. No tracking issue was identified.

**Safety and goldens**

The diff changes names, refusal text, and alias resolution. It changes no geometry calculation, collision check, stock simulation, or posted coordinate. A safety-tier mutation run does not apply. No mutations ran.

I checked all 11 changed `.refusal` goldens line by line. Only line 2 changes its refusal text. The `(user.cps:16:9)` locations remain unchanged. The posted job goldens do not change, and their Agie job checks pass.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:36` changes visible text. The post name, dialog messages, and Wire-page hint also change. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add before/after screenshots for the changed UI to the body. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images or review evidence to the PR branch.
2. **Class: incomplete legacy-project post test.** `crates/app/tests/wire_post_alias.rs:101` calls `script_source()`. This reads the CPS text; it does not post a job. Issue #4000 requires the opened legacy project to post and then save the new name. Extend the existing round-trip coverage to load a valid job with each old name. Post each loaded job to a new directory. Compare its ISO, SBR, and SBL files with the unchanged goldens. Then check that the save writes the new name. Apply this check to both old aliases.

No production-code defect was found. The two requested items concern required evidence and acceptance coverage. The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
